verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents an official MCP server (docs.firecrawl.dev/mcp-server.md, firecrawl-mcp-server GitHub repo) that lets any AI agent connect via the Model Context Protocol, with authentication options and clear setup instructions. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation from third-party users that the MCP server works reliably in practice, and more detail on tool coverage/limitations of the MCP integration.
